Hello WoT community! I'm Kylara, a <staff /> [[w:Help:Wiki Managers|Wiki Manager]].

I'm reaching out to you all to see what you think about documenting the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|upcoming TV series]] on the wiki. The TV series will hopefully be a big hit, and new fans will need a place to look for information as they watch!

So the big question is: '''Do you want this wiki to be the primary destination for information on ''The Wheel of Time'' television series?''' This would include featuring the TV series information prominently on the main page and in the top navigation, and possibly even in the layout. It will also include separate pages for the TV series versions of characters, and a separate category structure for that content. We would also make some [[w:Help:Best Practices|best practices]] updates, such as updating the main page.

Is there anything else you'd like to see changed on the wiki? Any area that could use some updates or focus? And what do you all think about enabling Discussions here?

Let me know! This is the place to discuss it.
